_note: The supplemental project register: named new launches and awarded sites that the URA transaction data does not hold (it holds only developments that have sales). Edit THIS file, then run `node tools/market-data/build-upcoming.js` and commit data/map/upcoming.json with it. See tools/market-data/UPCOMING.md for the lifecycle, the sources and the refresh steps.

auto._note: URA residential and mixed-use sites are added automatically from URA's 'URA Sale Sites' dataset at ANY age, until they are resolved: a development with URA sales sits inside the site, its URA completion year has passed, it is listed under an entry's `ura`, or it is in `resolved` below. When OneMap holds one project name '(U/C)' inside the site boundary the site takes that name (it keeps its id, and its old 'GLS site' name stays searchable as an alias); otherwise it is a GLS site with no project name yet. Put a site in `skip` to leave it out, or in `resolved` (key 'DATE_AWARD|LOCATION': reason) when you know it has launched or been completed.
